Setup instructions

Follow the practical guide

Original installation instructions

  1. Start from DeepSeek's official Harness page and read the README and SAFETY.md before choosing a supported download.
  2. Use a disposable practice workspace; configure an existing model with known billing in Settings > Models. Ask for a read-only summary of a fictional note. Expect a summary whose tool calls you can inspect.
Check before keeping it

Ask for one small result, inspect the output and permissions, and confirm it suits your app. If it fails, undo your changes and return to your original project.

Limits to keep in view
